admissions.reasonForAdmission: Acute severe substernal crushing chest pain radiating to left jaw, diaphoresis, dyspnea.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: High probability acute coronary syndrome with critical SpO2 (92%) and severe tachycardia.
factors: Tachycardia (HR 114 bpm) with systolic hypertension (172 mmHg)
Cardiovascular red flag: Crushing chest pain radiating to jaw
NEWS Score of 7 triggers immediate high-risk clinical escalation

admissions.admissionNotes: Direct admission via EMS. EKG shows ST-elevations in V2-V4. Prep for immediate cath lab activation.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Acute onset right-sided hemiparesis, expressive aphasia, facial droop noticed 1 hr prior.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Suspected acute ischemic stroke within therapeutic thrombolytic window. Requires STAT neuro ICU monitoring.

admissions.admissionNotes: Code Stroke initiated. Non-contrast head CT performed; candidate for IV thrombolysis. Strict neurological checks q15m.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Diabetic ketoacidosis secondary to severe gastroenteritis and dehydration. High blood glucose (480 mg/dL).

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Moderate metabolic derangement and pyrexia requiring IV fluid resuscitation and titrated regular insulin infusion.

admissions.admissionNotes: Initiate 2L Normal Saline over 4 hours. Start regular insulin protocol per sliding scale once potassium is checked.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Closed displaced fracture of the left tibial shaft following an accidental fall down stairs.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Hemodynamically stable isolated closed extremity fracture. Distal neurovascular status intact.
factors: Isolated orthopedic injury requiring elective surgical reduction

admissions.admissionNotes: Posterior splint applied in ED. NPO after midnight for scheduled open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) tomorrow morning.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Moderate acute asthma exacerbation unresponsive to home albuterol inhaler; audible expiratory wheezes.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Pediatric respiratory distress with borderline hypoxemia (SpO2 94%) requiring continuous nebulization.
factors: Tachypneic (RR 28) with increased work of breathing
SpO2 94% on room air requiring supplemental low-flow O2

admissions.admissionNotes: Nebulized Albuterol/Ipratropium q2h. Oral Prednisone 1 mg/kg. Maintain SpO2 > 95% via nasal cannula.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Exertional angina and recurrent paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia (PSVT) for elective telemetry monitoring.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Elective admission for continuous cardiac telemetry and medication adjustment. Patient is stable.
factors: Known history of coronary disease requiring telemetry observation
No active ischemia on resting baseline ECG

admissions.admissionNotes: Connect continuous telemetry leads. Order 2D Echocardiogram and 24-hr Holter review.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Severe intractable migraine with persistent vomiting for 48 hours, failing outpatient triptan therapy.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Intractable migraine with dehydration requiring IV antiemetics, IV rehydration, and dark quiet room recovery.
factors: Severe symptomatic pain requiring intravenous abortive cocktail
Private room indicated for noise and light sensitivity

admissions.admissionNotes: IV hydration with 1L D5 1/2 NS + IV Ondansetron + IV Ketorolac. Keep room dimmed.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Acute severe erosive gastritis with coffee-ground emesis.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: Upper GI bleeding requiring urgent endoscopy and IV proton-pump inhibitor therapy.

admissions.admissionNotes: Esophagogastroduodenoscopy performed; clean-based ulcer visualized. Hemostasis secured.
admissions.dischargeSummary: Patient responded well to high-dose IV Pantoprazole. Hemoglobin stabilized at 12.8 g/dL. Tolerating soft diet.

admissions.reasonForAdmission: Community-acquired bacterial lobar pneumonia with high fever and productive cough.

aiTriageAssessment.rationale: High fever and tachypnea with focal consolidation on chest radiograph.

admissions.admissionNotes: Started on IV Ceftriaxone + Azithromycin. Sputum culture collected.
admissions.dischargeSummary: Afebrile for 48 hours. SpO2 99% on room air. Step-down to oral Amoxicillin-Clavulanate for 5 days. Follow-up clinic in 2 weeks.
